Name: HostSwitcher
Author: lyneyy
Description:
[b][color=#6d9eeb]Endorse[/color][color=#a4c2f4] this mod if[/color] [color=#ead1dc]it helps [/color][color=#c27ba0]you  (*ฅ́˘ฅ̀*)♡[/color][/b]

[b][size=5]Description[/size][/b]
In Stardew Valley co-op, only the host's character can be played in single-player mode. This mod lets you swap which character holds the host slot before loading a save — so you can experience the game from any co-op farmer's perspective.

如果主持存档的朋友不再登录星露谷，但你对之前打拼的存档仍有留恋，可以通过这个mod一键将存档转移到自己的账号，从而保留珍贵的游戏回忆。

[b][size=3]This mod fits if you:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Want to keep the original host's full home and welcome them back anytime.[/*]
[*]Refuse to give up your own decorated house.[/*]
[*]Have a heavily modded save — editing XML risks breaking mod data.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]How to use
[/b]
[list=1]
[*]After loading your save, press [ (open bracket) while in-game to open the Host Switcher menu.[/*]
[*]Select the character you want to play as next session and confirm.[/*]
[*]Exit to the title screen and reload — you'll now be playing as that character.[/*]
[/list][b]Features
[/b]
[list]
[*]Each farmer stays in their original home — no forced relocation.[/*]
[*]The main farmhouse renders correctly for its actual resident: spouse room, extension rooms, and NPC decorations all display properly.[/*]
[*]Children remain in the correct house.[/*]
[*]In multiplayer, the spouse NPC, mail, and Return Scepter point to the actual resident's farmhouse.[/*]
[*]Farm-global progress (Ginger Island boat, farm cave choice) is preserved and won't replay.[/*]
[*]Your save is backed up automatically before the first swap. Restore anytime with ‘‘ hs_restore_original <save_folder> ’’ from the SMAPI console on the title screen.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]Console commands
[/b]
[table][tr][th]Command[/th]
[th]Description[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][code]hs_set_next_host <save> <farmer>[/code][/td]
[td]Queue a swap (alternative to the [ menu)[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][code]hs_cancel_swap <save>[/code][/td]
[td]Cancel a pending swap[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][code]hs_status[/code][/td]
[td]Show pending swap status[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][code]hs_inspect <save>[/code][/td]
[td]Show host and farmhand info from a save file[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][code]hs_restore_original <save>[/code][/td]
[td]Restore save to its original pre-mod state[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][code]hs_restore_savegameinfo <save>[/code][/td]
[td]Restore the save list display if it looks wrong[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][code]hs_set_key <name>[/code][/td]
[td]Change the menu key[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][code]hs_detect_key[/code][/td]
[td]Press any key to see its name (use before hs_set_key)[/td]
[/tr]
[/table][line]
[b]Known limitations
[/b]
[list]
[*]Same mod version required for all players in multiplayer. [/*]
[*]The original host needs a cabin to rejoin as farmhand. [/*]
[*]Uninstalling breaks the main farmhouse rendering. [/*]
[/list]
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later[/*]
[/list][line]
